target_customer: Sales, proposal and security teams at B2B companies answering RFPs and security questionnaires
problem: Responding to RFPs and questionnaires is slow and manual, with stale answer libraries.
product_category: AI RFP and questionnaire response automation

founders.name: Vishakh Hegde
founders.background_notes: Published ML papers per YC page.

founders.name: Gaurav Nemade
prior_employers: Google AI and Google Brain (PM on LaMDA)

competitors.name: RFPIO (now Responsive)
competitors.what: Strategic response management platform for RFPs, RFIs and security questionnaires
competitors.traction_then: Company release says nearly 2,000 companies used it and G2 ranked it first in RFP software in the Summer 2023 report (company claim)

technical_complexity.rationale: Retrieval over customer documents with grounded answer drafting and integrations; LLM tooling was newly available in 2023, so engineering was standard with accuracy challenges.

defensibility.rationale: Established RFP vendors and many AI-native entrants offered similar features; content libraries create modest lock-in.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Incumbents added AI features later according to 2026 vendor comparison pages; no acquisition of Inventive found.

market_need_then: Incumbent RFP tools relied on static libraries and generative AI had just become practical in 2023, creating an opening for AI-native drafting.

branding.domain_note: Uses inventive.ai, an exact .ai name; acquisition details not found.

identity.logo: Orange and blue mark (per homepage fetch)
identity.visual_style: Numbered feature sections with clean headings
identity.voice_and_tone: Confident, claim-driven with headline metrics such as 90% faster

brand_strength.rationale: Generic word shared with a separate startup called Inventive that raised a 6.5M seed in 2024; no press on the brand itself.

outcome_analysis: Inventive AI is active with about 15 staff, a 4 million dollar seed in August 2024 and an AI RFP Agent launch in April 2025. It rode the 2023 shift to LLMs against library-based incumbents. No Series A was found, so the later stage outcome is still open. Its name is confusable with another Inventive startup.
notes: Seed amount confirmed by pulse2 and European Business Magazine. Lead investor is unclear across aggregators so none is claimed. Persana reports 4.5M total including a 500K pre-seed in 2023-10, unverified. No dated competitor sources from 2023 were found (only 2026 vendor comparison pages), so the list was empty. RFPIO added from its own June 2023 company release; the GlobeNewswire copy returned 403. Loopio not added: only undated or review-site pages were found, not opened as a source dated by mid 2023. Founder Gaurav Nemade is listed on the YC page as Founder.
